slides.title: Main idea questions: ==kill the extremes== first
Too narrow, too broad
slides.body: One wrong choice restates a single detail from the passage. Another claims more than the passage ever says. The answer covers the **whole** text — and nothing beyond it.

slides.title: Watch for certainty
slides.body: Right answers hedge: *suggests*, *may*, *some researchers*. A short passage almost never *proves* anything — absolute language is usually the trap, not the answer.

slides.title: Seva doesn't just grade you. It tells you *why* you fell for the trap.
